vop_rule: badge valid (official check) AND agentWallet set AND payee account holds a business identity (Global FinReg)

check_payee_live_on_testnet_payees.note: invoice name used = the agent card name; UNVERIFIED means no name proof exists yet for the account; a MATCH needs a name proof plus a payee-signed binding, which no account outside PayOnce has published yet

check_payee_live_on_mainnet_payees.note: mainnet mode is identity-only: never MATCH, never payable. The payee book is testnet-only, so no mainnet account is bound to a legal name by its own signature

x402_sellers.unverified_means: no name proof exists yet for this payTo account (nobody has published one). It is not a statement about the seller's honesty, and every Concordium seller we found is in the same position.

changes_since_previous_run.meaning: payee = agentWallet, or the owner when unset. A changed payee on an existing token is the on-chain form of 'our bank details changed'.

verification.scope: Identity-provider attribution only, for every business-identity account plus a seeded random sample of the other accounts. It does not verify badges, cards or the full census.

wording.headline: At most 5 of 5,534 agents in the Concordium mainnet registry (0.09%) meet the preconditions of a Verification-of-Payee check today; on testnet, 3 of 1,556.
wording.upper_bound: These are upper bounds. 'Pass' only means the technical preconditions hold (valid Verified-by-Concordium badge, an agentWallet is set, and the account receiving payment holds a business identity from Global FinReg). It does not prove the legal name matches an invoice: that needs a payee-signed name binding (PayOnce v3, testnet) or a zero-knowledge name proof.

definitions.agents_total: Tokens returned by the registry's list_agents for the network, at generated_at_utc.
definitions.badge_valid_official: The registry's own check-badge endpoint (/v1/check-badge/{token}) returned badge_valid=true.
definitions.payee: The account that receives money for the agent: its agentWallet, or its owner when none is set (registry semantics).
definitions.business_identity: The payee account holds a credential issued by a business identity provider: Global FinReg (mainnet idp 3, testnet idp 4). Notabene, Digital Trust Solutions and Concordium's testnet IP issue personal identities.
definitions.agents_that_pass_vop_today: badge_valid_official AND agentWallet set AND payee holds a business identity.
definitions.payee_equals_owner_default: agentWallet is set and equals the owner. The registry defaults agentWallet to the owner on registration, so this is mostly the default, not a deliberate choice of a payee.
definitions.payee_not_set: No agentWallet on the token (payee falls back to the owner).

wording.sources: Registry lists and badge checks: Concordium's hosted agent-registry MCP/REST. Account identity providers: the public CCDExplorer account page (the census host cannot reach a node's gRPC port); the live check_payee reads the node directly. Cards: the agent_uri of each token, fetched once per run.
wording.sample_verification: Identity attribution verified on chain for a sample: mainnet: 26 of 26 accounts agree (all 1 business-identity accounts included); testnet: 35 of 35 accounts agree (all 10 business-identity accounts included). Each account's credentials were re-read from a Concordium node (getAccountInfo) on 2026-11-28 by github-actions. This verifies the identity-provider attribution for those accounts only, not badges, cards or every account in the census.
wording.x402_sellers_wording: For x402 sellers say: no name proof exists yet for its payTo account. Do not say the seller is unsafe, dishonest or fraudulent: UNVERIFIED is the answer for every Concordium seller found, including well-run ones.
does_not_claim: that a business identity belongs to the company named on an invoice
that accounts outside the registry or x402 sellers we did not probe behave the same
a count of all Concordium agents: only registered, listed tokens
